name: Purple Worm

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The purple worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack. It can replace one attack with a use of Swallow.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. 22 (3d8 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 22), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Actions.name: Tail Stinger
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d6 + 9) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Swallow
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 21, one Large or smaller creature within 10 feet that the purple worm hit with a melee attack this turn. *Failure:* The target is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the purple worm, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the purple worm's turns. If the purple worm takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the purple worm and has the Prone condition. If the purple worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.
Actions.gmQuote: purple worm that swallowed a war band's armoury

Traits.name: Iron Clang
Traits.text: A creature that touches the purple worm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.
Traits.expresses: blades and mail fused into its hide

Traits.name: Tunneler
Traits.text: The purple worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

lore: A purple worm that took a mercenary war-band down into its burrow with their entire armoury, and whose body has been slowly wearing the iron ever since.

generation.userConcept: Purple Worm — that swallowed a war-band's armoury
